reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but implements daily exclusion separately in getNextDate and both server handlers.

duplication.why: The daily weekend-and-holiday exclusion decision appears three times, and applyWeekendRule reimplements movement logic retained in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but the server handlers now own scheduling policy that should also live in that shared layer.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration propagation, and related tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three exclusion implementations and separate occurrence-fetching heuristics instead of extending one shared occurrence policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange decide daily exclusions outside applyWeekendRule, while shared/schedules.ts: applyWeekendRule replaces its delegation to getDateWithSkippedWeekend with independent movement logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily exclusion decision is reshaped as skipDailyWeekend plus find in getNextDate, dailySkip plus filter in getUpcomingDates, and an inline negated condition in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains holidays; getNextDate gains a daily-specific selection branch; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement that exclusion policy outside the shared adjustment helper.
